decks.notes: This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to fuel powerful effects like Mayhem Devil and Priest of Forgotten Gods. The key strategy involves using cards like Witch's Oven and Sacrifice to generate value from sacrificing creatures, while also dealing damage to the opponent with cards like Shrapnel Blast and Mayhem Devil. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats and disruption, utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board and maintain pressure. The goal is to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures with powerful synergies to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. By maximizing the efficiency of each card and leveraging anthem effects, the strategy revolves around building a wide board presence and using protection spells to push through damage and protect key threats. With a consistent mana base and a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil, while also utilizing sacrifice outlets like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute to generate value and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board and ensure your creatures can get through for damage. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By combining powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, it aims to control the board while dealing damage. Chandra, Torch of Defiance provides additional removal and card advantage, while cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide recurring threats. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure consistency and mana fixing, allowing for a smooth aggressive strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to flood the board with cheap, efficient creatures and use them to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By playing low-cost creatures with strong abilities like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Luminarch Aspirant, this deck aims to apply pressure early and often. Additionally, cards like Brave the Elements can help protect your creatures from removal spells, allowing them to keep turning sideways and attacking. Using Anthem effects like Thalia's Lieutenant and Castle Ardenvale can help to boost the power of your board even further.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks and enchantments like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and then play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage while Nissa, Vital Force and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner help to further ramp and protect the board. The inclusion of red and blue planeswalkers like Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God adds extra versatility and threat diversity to the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply pressure early on, using efficient creatures like Anax, Hardened in the Forge and Kari Zev, Skyship Raider. Eidolon of the Great Revel punishes opponents for casting spells, while Torbran, Thane of Red Fell boosts the damage output of all red sources. Burn spells like Play with Fire and creatures like Bonecrusher Giant help finish off the opponent. The deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing evasive flying Spirits to pressure the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan with tempo plays such as countering spells and exiling threats. By leveraging the synergy between Spirit creatures and anthems like Empyrean Eagle and Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to close out games swiftly. Collected Company provides card advantage and helps to deploy threats at instant speed. The manabase is designed to support the deck's dual color requirements while providing flexibility for casting spells efficiently.

The main goal of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly and aggressively, using efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser. It also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck has some powerful late-game threats like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to finish the game. The mana base is designed to support both black and red spells, allowing for flexibility in casting spells while attacking the opponent's life total relentlessly.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang, Okiba Boss along with various cards like Raffine's Informant, Satyr Wayfinder, and Thoughtseize to set up the combo. Can't Stay Away and Witherbloom Command help generate additional value while Grisly Salvage and Traverse the Ulvenwald provide deck manipulation. Esika's Chariot and Parhelion II are key combo pieces that work well together. The deck also includes removal spells like Duress and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to control the board. With a mix of lands to support its colors, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently to win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful burn spells. It aims to quickly put pressure on the opponent, dealing damage early and often. The use of efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Runaway Steam-Kin combined with impactful spells like Light Up the Stage and Reckless Rage allows for a quick and aggressive playstyle. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Torbran, Thane of Red Fell and Embercleave amplify the damage output of the deck, making it difficult for opponents to keep up with the fast pace of the game.

The deck focuses on aggressive, creature-centered strategies with a splash of disruption and removal. It utilizes a mix of powerful aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, along with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the tempo of the game. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Sorin the Mirthless provides additional threats and card advantage. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck can apply pressure early with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant, while also generating value with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Chandra, Torch of Defiance. The deck aims to finish the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with its aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also having some resiliency with cards like Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet and Graveyard Trespasser.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive green creatures while also building up devotion to green mana symbols. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to ramp up mana and generate card advantage. The deck also includes strong green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to pressure the opponent. With cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven, the deck can generate massive amounts of mana and play multiple threats in a single turn, overwhelming the opponent with its aggression.

This deck focuses on utilizing spells that draw cards and fill the graveyard to quickly bring back Arclight Phoenixes from the graveyard for aggressive attacks. The deck also includes ways to protect the Phoenixes, such as Spell Pierce and Galvanic Iteration, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Lava Coil and Lightning Axe. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise provides additional card advantage and can help close out games quickly. Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide alternative win conditions if needed.

The deck focuses on utilizing spirit creatures with flying and other abilities to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By deploying threats like Empyrean Eagle and Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to build a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist. Collected Company allows for additional creatures to be put into play at instant speed, providing flexibility in response to the opponent's actions. The mana base is designed to consistently allow for the deck's color requirements to be met and ensure a smooth curve of creatures.
